info.name: eric-api
info.description:
ELSTER submissions through the eric-api.

Start the service:
  cd solobooks-eric-api && docker compose up -d
  curl http://localhost:5000/health

Every request carries Testmerker 700000004 - these are TEST submissions,
nothing is filed with a Finanzamt.

The /validate requests need no certificate and work immediately.
The /submit requests need cert_base64 and cert_password set below
(Variables tab), then Save.

  base64 -i your-cert.pfx | tr -d '\n' | pbcopy

STATUS
  ESt (annual return)  validates, returns a PDF
  UStVA (VAT return)   validates, returns a PDF
  ZMDO (ZM)            BROKEN - see the folder description

item.name: ESt - annual income tax return
item.description:
A complete 2025 return: single filer, freelance software developer,
24.500 EUR profit, test Finanzamt 1096.

Derived from the ERiC schema documentation - see
postman/README-ESt-sample.md for the field constraints that matter.

body.raw: { "xml": " ElsterErklaerung ESt send-Auth 700000004 97263 Solobooks Test CMSEncryptedData GZIP 1 1096 X 1096 01.01.1985 Mustermann Max 11 Musterstrasse 1 10115 Berlin X PersonA Softwareentwicklung 24500 10 01 1096081508152 2025 Max Mustermann Musterstr. 1 10115 Berlin Solobooks S 1 INTERNET " }

request.description:
No datenartversion passed - detected from the E10 namespace.
Expect 200, "valid": true, <Erfolg/> in validation_result.

body.raw: { "xml": " ElsterErklaerung ESt send-Auth 700000004 97263 Solobooks Test CMSEncryptedData GZIP 1 1096 X 1096 01.01.1985 Mustermann Max 11 Musterstrasse 1 10115 Berlin X PersonA Softwareentwicklung 24500 10 01 1096081508152 2025 Max Mustermann Musterstr. 1 10115 Berlin Solobooks S 1 INTERNET ", "datenartversion": "ESt_2025" }

request.description:
Same document, datenartversion pinned. Identical result -
detection and the explicit value agree.

body.raw: { "xml": " ElsterErklaerung ESt send-Auth 700000004 97263 Solobooks Test CMSEncryptedData GZIP 1 1096 X 1096 01.01.1985 Mustermann Max 11 Musterstrasse 1 10115 Berlin X PersonA Softwareentwicklung 24500 10 01 1096081508152 2025 Max Mustermann Musterstr. 1 10115 Berlin Solobooks S 1 INTERNET ", "cert_base64": "{{cert_base64}}", "password": "{{cert_password}}", "datenartversion": "ESt_2025", "return_pdf": true }

request.description:
Needs a certificate. Response body is the PDF - use Send and Download.

Check the response HEADERS:
  X-Transferticket   the real ELSTER receipt
  X-Transfer-Handle  a different value entirely, not a receipt

body.raw: { "xml": " ElsterErklaerung ESt send-Auth 700000004 97263 Solobooks Test CMSEncryptedData GZIP 1 1096 X 1096 01.01.1985 Mustermann Max 11 Musterstrasse 1 10115 Berlin X PersonA Softwareentwicklung 24500 10 01 1096081508152 2025 Max Mustermann Musterstr. 1 10115 Berlin Solobooks S 1 INTERNET ", "cert_base64": "{{cert_base64}}", "password": "{{cert_password}}", "datenartversion": "ESt_2025", "return_pdf": false }

request.description:
Same, as JSON so both fields are visible side by side:
  transferticket   string, the receipt
  transfer_handle  int, unchanged
pdf_base64 carries the PDF.

item.name: UStVA - VAT return

item.name: ZMDO - Zusammenfassende Meldung (BROKEN)
item.description:
These requests FAIL, and that is the current, real behaviour -
reproduced in production on 2026-09-06.

ERiC returns 610301006 'Fehler beim Parsen der Eingabedaten' and
reports every element inside <zm> as undefined, including the root's
own version attribute. No ZM has ever been filed through the product.

Note the datenartversion is ZMDO with NO year (plugin libcheckZMDO.so).
ZM_2025 - which models.py documents - is rejected as unknown.

Root cause is not yet established. The zm fragment on its own validates
against zm_000005.xsd, yet ERiC rejects it inside the envelope, so the
namespace explanation is incomplete. Keep these requests as the
regression check: when they return 200 with a PDF, the bug is fixed.

body.raw:
{
  "xml": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Elster xmlns="http://www.elster.de/elsterxml/schema/v11">
  <TransferHeader version="11">
    <Verfahren>ElsterExtern</Verfahren>
    <DatenArt>ZMDO</DatenArt>

    <DatenLieferant>Max Mustermann</DatenLieferant>
    <Datei>
      <Verschluesselung>CMSEncryptedData</Verschluesselung>
      <Kompression>GZIP</Kompression>
      <TransportSchluessel/>
    </Datei>
  </TransferHeader>
  <DatenTeil>
    <Nutzdatenblock>
      <NutzdatenHeader version="11">
        <NutzdatenTicket>1</NutzdatenTicket>
        <Empfaenger id="L">BF</Empfaenger>
      </NutzdatenHeader>
      <Nutzdaten>
        <zm version="000005">
          <unternehmer>
            <knri>DE123456789</knri>
            <zulassNr>
              <zulnr1>N</zulnr1>
              <zulnr2>1111111</zulnr2>
            </zulassNr>
            <anschrift>
              <name>Max Mustermann</name>
              <strasse>Musterstrasse</strasse>
              <hausnr>1</hausnr>
              <plz>10115</plz>
              <ort>Berlin</ort>
              <staat>DE</staat>
            </anschrift>
            <zm-zeilen waehrung="1" meldeart="10">
              <anzeige>false</anzeige>
              <widerruf>false</widerruf>
              <mzr>
                <quart>1</quart>
                <jahr>2025</jahr>
              </mzr>
              <zeile umsatzart="L">
                <knre>FR12345678901</knre>
                <betrag>5000</betrag>
              </zeile>
              <zeile umsatzart="L">
                <knre>NL123456789B01</knre>
                <betrag>2500</betrag>
              </zeile>
            </zm-zeilen>
          </unternehmer>
        </zm>
      </Nutzdaten>
    </Nutzdatenblock>
  </DatenTeil>
</Elster>
",
  "datenartversion": "ZMDO"
}
